title: How a Godly Man Texts the Same Way He Prays
caption:
Read your last group chat. Now read your last prayer. Same guy?

You've got a church voice, a gym voice, and an 11 PM group chat voice. Three different guys on one phone. The group chat is usually the truest one, because it's the one you're not performing for.

God already knows that guy. Hiding him from church doesn't hide him from God. What stays in the dark keeps growing. What you drag into the light starts to shrink. Pick one voice and let it win everywhere.

#faith #integrity #godlyman #christianmen #authenticity
